01 / THE 2026–2027 SEASON

Something to
play for.

Your guide to this season’s formats, standings and weekly play.

Talk league with our team
01Dates & registration

Week 1 starts October 26, 2026.

Registration for the 2026/2027 league is now closed. Stay tuned for our Majors league beginning in April and for upcoming spring and summer leagues.

Registration closed
02Format & teams
  • Formats — Enter one or more divisions. Play individually or compete in a 2-person or 4-person Texas Scramble. All divisions play without handicaps.
  • Regular season — 16 weeks of play, with eight weeks before Christmas and eight after New Year’s.
  • Standings — Your best 12 of 16 weekly scores count toward the standings.
  • Playoffs — All flights are included in the early March playoffs. We’ll announce the dates and format later.
  • Substitutes — Only 4-person teams may use substitutes, and only during the regular season.
  • Cost — A one-time registration fee of $25 per player, per division, plus standard simulator bay rates.
03Rules & weekly play
  • One drink ticket per player, per round, redeemable for an alcoholic or non-alcoholic beverage.
  • Weekly contests and challenges.
  • A live leaderboard to follow the competition.
  • Random prize draws featuring clubs, free golf at courses around Manitoba, Jets tickets, merch, pizza parties, gift cards and more!
  • Approximate tee lengths:
    Men: 6,400 yards
    Ages 55+: 6,000 yards
    Women: 5,200 yards
